name: EPIC 212005960
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 7.3 solar radii and 1.08 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212005960 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.339254 (16th-84th percentiles 7.088091-7.600241), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212005960: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4691.236 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212005960 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1033.164062 (16th-84th percentiles 1004.863281-1062.421875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.10 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 1,033 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.08 solar masses and 7.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,691 K at its surface.
